question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Haphaazard"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is "**Haphazard**".
 
• **"Haphazard" **refers to something that is lacking any obvious principle of organization; random. (अव्यवस्थित)
 
 
• ​Example: The books were arranged in a haphazard manner on the shelves.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Connoisseur **(पारखी): An expert judge in matters of taste.

 
 
• **Example:** He is a **connoisseur **of fine wines.
 
 
 
• **Diffusion **(प्रसार): The spreading of something more widely.
 
 
• **Example: **The **diffusion **of new technology has revolutionized the industry.
 
 
 
• **Appropriate** (उचित): Suitable or proper in the circumstances.
 
 
• **Example:** It is important to wear **appropriate **clothing for the occasion.
